source.subtitle: PR #74 / Completed r7 A100 comparison / Frozen 666-target primary reference
notes: Both-corner columns count successes within 5 and 10 original-image pixels. Each denominator is 584 eligible fronts; eligible misses remain failures. Detection uses all 666 fronts, including those with fewer than two locatable corners.
Against the control, the candidate loses 9 matches and adds 15 unmatched outputs. It gains 4 five-pixel pair successes but loses 2 ten-pixel pair successes. PR35 remains selected.

A scored miss can be an extent disagreement: new010:15 still has a confident proposal at IoU 0.4973, below the fixed 0.50 match cutoff. The new057:11 frozen box visibly includes rack below its front. Neither observation changes the recorded score or frozen reference.
PR35 and the fresh r7 control have exactly equal decoded prediction arrays on all 20 fixed images at this operating point. Their checkpoint bytes differ; behavior elsewhere is not established.
